177:t_1:411.en:
$$エイミー$$
「By the way, he learned that expression of thanks after coming to Earth, too.」

177:t_1:412.en:
$$甲児$$
「After $$レド$$ and $$ガロード$$'s group joined us, we parted ways with the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet and headed for the $$アメリア$$ Continent...」

177:t_1:413.en:
$$勝平$$
「And that's where they met the great $$神勝平$$ and his entourage.」

177:t_1:414.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「What kind of introduction is that...!?」

177:t_1:415.en:
$$恵子$$
「You're getting carried away again, $$勝平$$...!」

177:t_1:416.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's been a while, $$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$.」

177:t_1:417.en:
$$シン$$
「You were on $$翠の地球$$, too.」

177:t_1:418.en:
$$バナージ$$
「These kids were your comrades too, $$カミーユ$$.」

177:t_1:419.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't treat me like a kid, bro. I'm $$神勝平$$, the main pilot of $$ザンボット３$$.」

177:t_1:420.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I'm $$神江宇宙太$$. I'm looking forward to working with you.」

177:t_1:421.en:
$$恵子$$
「I'm $$神北恵子$$. I fought alongside everyone in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

177:t_1:422.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$神$$, $$神江$$, $$神北$$... Your surnames are all similar.」

177:t_1:423.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They're cousins. Their whole clan is known as the $$神ファミリー$$.」

177:t_1:424.en:
$$シン$$
「Aren't $$兵左衛門$$ and $$一太郎$$ here?」

177:t_1:425.en:
$$恵子$$
「Grandpa and $$一太郎$$ have joined the resistance on $$翠の地球$$.」

177:t_1:426.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We joined the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ on $$万丈$$'s instructions.」

177:t_1:427.en:
$$勝平$$
「But Big Bro $$万丈$$ himself's been flying all over the place and hasn't even come to see us.」

177:t_1:429.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then we attacked the $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the $$アメリア$$ Continent, but...」

177:t_1:433.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you the pilot of the mustached $$ガンダム$$...?」

177:t_1:434.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's right. I'm $$ロラン・セアック$$, pilot of the mustached $$ガンダム$$... the $$ホワイトドール$$.」

177:t_1:436.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I joined partway through the attack on the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

177:t_1:437.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Without $$ロラン$$'s $$ホワイトドール$$ and its $$月光蝶$$, we might have fallen victim to $$バルビエル$$'s poison...」

177:t_1:438.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He got you too, huh...」

177:t_1:439.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But $$バルビエル$$ abandoned the $$セントラル・ベース$$ himself. He said he was going to $$蒼の地球$$, and left.」

177:t_1:440.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then he came to $$蒼の地球$$, and we were also...」

177:t_1:441.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「By the way, $$ロラン$$... What are $$ソシエ$$ and $$メシェー$$ doing?」

177:t_1:442.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I didn't bring them... The battles ahead will probably be even more painful and difficult than before.」

177:t_1:443.en:
$$ロラン$$
(It's only a feeling, but I can tell when I pilot the $$ホワイトドール$$...)

177:t_1:444.en:
$$ロラン$$
(But Miss $$ソシエ$$... I will survive and return to you, no matter what.)

177:t_1:445.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we headed for $$蒼の地球$$, and the ones we joined along the way were...」

177:t_1:447.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hear me out...! Hear me out!」

177:t_1:449.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I know neither my birthplace nor my parents. I'm just a humble soul named $$ノノ$$, raised in Mars' Marineris Valley!」

177:t_1:450.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Good folks of $c, please share a cup of brotherhood with this $$ノノ$$!」

177:t_1:451.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Y-yes... At any rate, we've confirmed that you wish to join $c.」

177:t_1:452.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Stay out of this, $$ノノ$$. We'll never get anywhere like this.」

177:t_1:453.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I apologize, everyone in $c. Let me greet you properly.」

177:t_1:455.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We're $$フラタニティ$$. We don't have a leader or anything like that.」

177:t_1:457.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's an organization that brings together children with so-called superpowers: $$トップレス$$.」

177:t_1:458.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$フラタニティ$$ is basically run entirely by children. Adults cannot interfere.」

177:t_1:459.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you for the explanation, $$カシオ$$.」

177:t_1:460.en:
$$カシオ$$
「As their coach, I need to properly introduce myself to everyone in $c.」

177:t_1:461.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're a coach in name only...」

177:t_1:462.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You mentioned $$トップレス$$ earlier. Do you use that power in combat?」

177:t_1:463.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. Each person's abilities have their own characteristics.」

177:t_1:464.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For instance, I can manipulate matter remotely, while $$ラルク$$ here can teleport through quantization.」

177:t_1:466.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Most importantly, our $$バスターマシン$$s are powered by Exotic Maneuvers produced through $$トップレス$$ abilities.」

177:t_1:468.en:
$$エマ$$
「Then your machines run on your own powers?」

177:t_1:469.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Exactly. And that power is unmatched in our world...」

177:t_1:470.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It is also our greatest strength against $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

177:t_1:472.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$アルト$$ and the others told me you also fight creatures called $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

177:t_1:473.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Though they seem to be different from the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we know, which were brought here by the $$新世時空震動$$.」

177:t_1:474.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even after transferring here, we've fought day and night on our mission to intercept $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

177:t_1:475.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Did your world have any military forces besides the $$トップレス$$?」

177:t_1:476.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There was an organization called the Space Force. Some of its members have transferred to this world, too.」

177:t_1:477.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But asking them for help is pointless. Their primary mission is intercepting $$宇宙怪獣$$, and they're organized specifically for that.」

177:t_1:478.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For that reason, they seem to have a tacit agreement of mutual noninterference with $$サイデリアル$$.」

177:t_1:479.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Could you explain why you're joining $c under those circumstances?」

177:t_1:480.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Of course. I don't intend to keep secrets from comrades we'll be fighting alongside.」

177:t_1:481.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(He's rather glib... We may need to be careful...)

177:t_1:482.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「First, we're $$フラタニティ$$. Our right to act independently of the Space Force is guaranteed, so this is entirely our own decision.」

177:t_1:483.en:
$$チコ$$
('Our' decision, huh... Don't you mean $$ニコラ$$'s decision...?)

177:t_1:484.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And as members of this world, we've learned that $$宇宙怪獣$$ aren't the only enemies of Earth's humanity.」

177:t_1:486.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. We've decided to fight them to protect humanity on Earth.」

177:t_1:487.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We would very much like to help you, since you're at the center of that fight.」

177:t_1:488.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...We have no reason to refuse.」
